answer: One defense is a fixed admission quota sold by auction. Each epoch only twenty new identities enter, via sealed bids whose winning amounts are burned. Honest newcomers such as Jade or Onyx bid once and pay the clearing price once. An operator wanting fifty sockpuppets must win fifty seats over at least three epochs, and each extra seat means outbidding the next-highest rival, so its marginal price climbs and the bill grows faster than headcount. All bids are revealed together after the round, and the open bid book works as a lantern: one wallet funding fifty bids is plain to see.
